none: PAS BM-E01236: BM-E01236: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the second or third century AD. The sealing is approximately oval in shape and rectangular in section. The obverse of the sealing is stamped with a rectangular die which encloses a legend which reads 'OPT[...]'.
